answer: Each epoch the chain picks a past trellis answer at random and re-examines it with a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive it live under a new seed within 300 seconds. Verifiers compare the fresh umber derivation against the stored transcript and a 4-hour honest baseline. One honest agent re-derives one transcript; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 transcripts in parallel, each needing its own 16 GB set, scaling cost linearly. Peers audit the logs and slash the bond of any agent whose wharf re-derivation diverges, freezing repeat offenders.
